id: title:Gilbert09:scope the examples fetch to a dataset

review.posthog_relevance: Adds bounded ingestion and resumability for warehouse example fetching, preventing unbounded memory consumption and allowing recovery from interrupted imports.
review.reason: The change implements a bounded byte-cap and page-limit guard for dataset IDs, adds a dataset_id field to preserve state for resuming interrupted fetches, and paginates the examples fetch with checkpointing. This demonstrates a substantive, bounded capability improvement for warehouse ingestion reliability and resource protection.
review.uncertainty: The tier relies on the supplied observations; no independent verification of actual production incidents or adoption is available. The benefit is demonstrated by the implementation and checks, not by unverified outcomes.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, complete change group. No missing context or unrelated PRs detected. No score assigned; tier requires assessment of implementation and checks.

observations.behavior: Adds a 2MB byte-cap and page-limit guard for dataset IDs collected while scoping an examples query; this prevents unbounded memory or request consumption.
observations.posthog_connection: Warehouse ingestion could otherwise stream unbounded dataset IDs from LangSmith; this caps the accumulated bytes and raises an error if exceeded.

observations.behavior: Adds a dataset_id field to the resume config, preserving which dataset an interrupted examples fetch was paging.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows resuming an interrupted examples import from the exact dataset and offset rather than restarting or skipping datasets.

observations.behavior: Implements a paginated, dataset-scoped examples fetch with byte and page limits, checkpointing per dataset and raising on oversized ID sets or page limits.
observations.posthog_connection: Provides bounded, resumable ingestion of examples across all datasets while respecting the configured page and byte limits.
